themes.consensus_view: Banks broadly agree the AI infrastructure spending cycle remains intact and is a dominant driver of equity, semiconductor, and even import-trade flows into 2026.

banks_for: Merrill Lynch / Bank of America Chief Investment Office
evidence_quotes: spend on AI infrastructure has shown little fatigue
AI investment and deployment themes as fundamentally intact
reaffirming the AI and semiconductor cycle as the dominant market theme of 2026

AI-related demand for computer equipment is accounting for a rapidly growing share of US import value.
